pages.task: Subject: "Summon Treant" earth opening for a giant tree guardian to rise. ONE grid cell, base on the lower middle of the cell, width about 90% of cell. Do NOT draw the Treant itself. Frame 1: the soil bulges, hairline cracks, a few pebbles jump. Frames 2-3: the ground splits, dark moist earth and dust billow, thick mossy oak roots (bark #6b4423/#8c5a2b, moss green) snake up out of the crack curling inward. Frames 4-5: peak: a ring of tall thick roots circles an empty dark central opening, soft living gold-green light (#d8f59a) glows from inside the gap, soil clods fly, oak leaves swirl. Frames 6-7: roots settle outward and lower, dust and leaves drift down, glow softens. Frame 8: low roots, broken soil, faint dust. The centre top stays open and see-through so the Treant sprite can be shown there.
pages.checkRules:
- Exactly 2:1, 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal cells; NO grid lines/borders/numbers/text.
- Background really transparent (no black, no magenta residue, no dark halo, no black rectangle); corners and cell borders transparent.
- Every frame fully inside its cell with transparent margin; no content crossing cell borders; no empty frame.
- Frames form one smooth animation: same centre/size logic between neighbours, no sudden jump, frame 1 visible, frame 8 fading remnant.
- One bold readable subject per frame, hand-painted medieval style, no neon/sci-fi/purple/noise, no characters, no text.
- Reads as soil cracking + thick mossy oak roots rising around an open centre with soft gold-green light; the Treant itself is NOT drawn.
- Base anchored at the same ground point in all frames; peak at frames 4-5; centre-top see-through.
